Qiankun media taxonomy has three layers: level1 media system roughly maps to v2 platform, level2 media appears in selectList(mediaList) and accountIndex.media_master_id, level3 media resource position appears in /tf/ad/index mediaId[] and historical monitor media_id. os=3 means Qiankun mini-game technical system type; business media ownership is decided by platform/media/media_id/monitor_api/channel together. Level3 media_resource_id 310 was manually confirmed for provision MPR-OCEANENGINE-3-BYTE-MINI-GAME-JSZC-1871922346964041 and evidence EV-QK-MANUAL-L3-CONFIRM-OCEANENGINE-3-BYTE-MINI-GAME-JSZC-1871922346964041-310 was written. historical monitor 245791 exposes media_id=310, monitor_api=toutiao_wxgame, agent_id=613, and account 1871922175825993. monitor_id 245828 was read back via /tf/ad/index on 2026-08-26, belongs to old account 1871922346964041, and has been written back locally as the effective monitor_id with touchpoint hash only; the old account still has two failed attempt audit rows and third create remains forbidden. JSZC monitor callback contract is now required in game_route_defaults: server_callback_type=2 and server_callback_data_types=active/register/success_order. monitor:ensure now has a unified first-create/retry attempt policy: attempt_count=0 -> first_create, attempt_count=1 + server_busy -> retry, attempt_count>=2 -> blocked.
